# Introduction {#intro .unnumbered}

This is an **R Markdown** document: *emphasis*, __strong__, _also emphasis_, ***both***,
~~strikethrough~~, `inline code`, superscript^2^, subscript~2~, and a footnote.[^note]
Inline R: the week ending `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B")` had `r nrow(orders)` orders.
A parameter: `r params$warehouse`. Citations: [@smith2020; @jones2021, p. 12], @smith2020, [-@jones2021].

[^note]: The footnote body.

## Chunks

```{r load, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
orders <- read.csv("orders.csv")
paid <- orders %>% filter(status == "paid")
summary_tbl <- paid %>%
  group_by(status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), revenue = sum(total))
```

```{r plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=3, fig.cap="Paid orders", dev="png", out.width="80%"}
ggplot(paid, aes(number, total)) +
  geom_point(colour = "#336699") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```

```{r table, results='asis'}
knitr::kable(summary_tbl, caption = "Revenue by status", digits = 2)
```

```{r cached, cache=TRUE, eval=FALSE, include=TRUE, echo=-1}
Sys.sleep(1)
```
